name: Auburn/FastNoiseSIMD
description: A C++ noise library accelerated with SIMD CPU intrinsics (SSE2 through AVX512) achieving up to 700% speed improvements over scalar implementations for Perlin, Simplex, Cellular, and Value noise. Intended for high-performance terrain and texture generation at runtime.
score_rationale: Best-in-class performance noise library for CPU-bound generation pipelines using SIMD vectorization.
summary: SIMD-accelerated noise library achieving 700% speedup using CPU intrinsics (SSE2-AVX512).
